decisions.rationale: The disease name 'adenomatous polyposis coli' modifies the noun 'patients' in the title, parallel to the guideline example 'colorectal cancer families', so it is a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: Section 3: Disease mentions used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: Here 'adenomatous polyposis coli' is the disease itself, the object of 'causes', and it names one specific disease rather than a family of diseases.
'condition' is a very general term with no specific disease identity, so it is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4: Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: 'colorectal cancer' is named as the disease caused by predisposition and is treated as one specific disease entity, consistent with the guideline example 'early onset colorectal cancer'.
decisions.guideline_section: Section 1: Specific Disease mentions; Examples 2 and 7

decisions.rationale: 'syndrome' is a general term referring back to adenomatous polyposis coli without naming a disease, so it is excluded.
decisions.guideline_section: What NOT to Annotate 4: Do not annotate general terms

decisions.rationale: 'congenital hypertrophy of the retinal pigment epithelium' is the full name of one specific ocular disease, so the whole phrase is annotated as the minimum necessary span.
decisions.guideline_section: Section 1: Specific Disease mentions; Section 5: Minimum necessary span

decisions.rationale: 'CHRPE' is the abbreviation of the long form in the previous span and is a separate synonymous mention of the same specific disease.
'CHRPE' is the object of 'expressing' and is not modifying a noun, so it is a specific disease mention; the repeated mention is annotated as a duplicate.
decisions.guideline_section: Section 4: Duplicate mentions; Section 1: Specific Disease mentions

decisions.rationale: In 'The extent of CHRPE', CHRPE is a prepositional complement that refers to the disease itself and does not modify another noun, so it is a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: Section 1: Specific Disease mentions; Section 4: Duplicate mentions

decisions.rationale: In 'CHRPE lesions', the disease name modifies the noun 'lesions', so it is annotated as a Modifier, parallel to 'colorectal cancer families'.
decisions.guideline_section: Section 3: Disease mentions used as Modifiers for other concepts
